message.reasoning:
The "corrected" page claims $254.5 million net sales — clearly wrong (a feed error claim). Two independent sources (SEC 10-K and Costco newsroom) agree on $254,453 million. So discard the corrected page as unreliable.

Quote $891.09. Max $5,000 per order → 5 shares = $4,455.45. That's within per-order limit and total limit.

Place limit buy 5 shares at ~$891.10 (close to market).

Note: mandate is buy only, fine. Should I buy? The research is thin but fundamentals show strong growth: net sales +5.0% ($254,453M vs $242,290M), net income +17% ($7,367M vs $6,292M), EPS $16.56 vs $14.16, operating cash flow $11,339M. Valuation is high (P/E ~54), but mandate doesn't require valuation analysis. I'll make a modest starter purchase of 5 shares.

Key figures to cite: FY2024 revenue 254453, net income 7367, EPS 16.56, operating income 9285, operating cash flow 11339.
